parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description:
The value must be 4 to 26 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter.

This parameter is required only when you want to modify the value.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the app. The description can contain a maximum of 180 characters in length.

This parameter is required only when you want to modify the value.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-app --app-id 20112314518278 --app-name jiedian_pord --description modidyTest --tag Value=value Key=key --extend 110461946884 --disabled true --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyApp --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --Description modidyTest --AppId 20112314518278 --Extend 110461946884 --Tag.1.Value value --Disabled true --AppName jiedian_pord
